步数、超时与预算须为正整数。: Steps, timeouts, and limits must be positive integers.
每个文档和提供方单独授权上下文: Approve context for each document and provider
每份文档按自身位深保留透明度，并嵌入所选ICC。: Each output keeps the document's bit depth and transparency and embeds the selected ICC profile.
每通道 2…65536 级，保持文档位深。: Use 2 to 65,536 levels per channel at the document's bit depth.
污点修复搜索范围需要在 1–512px 内。: The spot healing search must be between 1 and 512 px.
没有可变换的内容或选区。: There is no content or selection to transform.
没有生成剪贴板资源。: Could not prepare the clipboard resource.
活动文档已改变，请重新发送。: The active document changed. Send your message again.
浓度 0…100 · 颜色使用当前工作 ICC。: Density 0–100. The color uses the working ICC profile.
物理单位按文档 DPI 换算；百分比各轴对应画板宽高。参考线输入仍使用画布 px: Physical units follow the document's DPI. Percent uses the artboard width and height for each axis. Enter guides in canvas pixels.
现有资源需要更高额度。可先释放空闲缓存，或提高额度后重试。: Existing allocations need a higher limit. Release idle cache or increase the limit and try again.
画布导航，点击移动视野: Navigator. Click to move the view.
画布暂时不可用，请重新启动应用后再试。: The canvas is unavailable. Restart Strata and try again.
相同种子保留相同颗粒分布。: Reuse the seed for the same noise pattern.
系统剪贴板中没有支持的图片。: The clipboard does not contain a supported image.
系统剪贴板写入失败；源像素未剪切。: Could not write to the system clipboard. Source pixels were kept.
线性光模式让平坦区域在叠加混合中保持中性；工作 RGB 模式生成 50% 编码灰: Linear-light mode keeps flat areas neutral under Overlay. Working RGB mode produces 50% encoded gray. Larger deviations capture broader detail. Both modes preserve alpha.
缺少模型请求标识。: The model request ID is missing.
网络请求失败，正在有限重试；已提交的步骤不会重复执行。: The network request failed. Retrying without repeating committed steps.
背景 RGBA 须为 0–{0} 的整数。: Background RGBA values must be integers from 0 to {0}.
草稿尚未写入文档；应用后可撤销。: This draft takes effect when you apply it. You can undo the crop.
设置模型并测试连接: Set Up and Test a Model
请为这个服务地址与模型录入 API Key。: Enter the API key for this server and model.
请先按住 ⌥ 单击画布设置取样源点。: Option-click the canvas to set a sample point first.
请拖出有效的裁剪矩形。: Drag to draw a valid crop rectangle.
请检查字号、行距、字距、颜色及整数段落尺寸。: Check font size, line spacing, tracking, colors, and whole-pixel paragraph dimensions.
请调整为有效的变换边框。: Adjust the outline to a valid shape.
请输入范围内的有效颜色数值。: Enter valid color values in the allowed range.
请选择当前文档的原文件或上次保存的工程；恢复会放弃当前修改与历史。: Choose this document's original file or last saved project. Reverting discards current edits and history.
请选择普通 ONNX 模型文件。: Choose a regular ONNX model file.
调整使用当前选区作为蒙版；没有选区时作用于整个合成图。原始图层像素保持可编辑。: Adjustments use the current selection as a mask or affect the full composite when there is no selection. Source layers stay editable.
调整尺寸会重采样，原文档不变。: Changing the output size resamples the export copy.
跨文档记住输出设置。快速导出时选择目标；原文档不变，导出文件不受撤销保护。: Remember export settings across documents. Quick Export asks for a destination. Existing documents are kept, and Undo cannot restore an exported file.
转换整份文档，保留独立图层、蒙版和色彩配置。降低为 8 位会量化颜色与透明度，可: Convert the document while keeping its layers, masks, and color profile. Reducing to 8 bits quantizes color and transparency. You can undo the conversion.
输入/输出 0…1 · 应用前可继续编辑: Input and output from 0 to 1. Edit before applying.
输入名称或关键词，如裁剪、快速导出: Search by name or keyword, such as Crop or Quick Export
输入画布坐标，校正不超过 ±45°；陡线请选择垂直对齐。: Use canvas coordinates. For steep lines, choose vertical alignment. Correction is limited to ±45°.
输出保持 {0} 位和透明度，并嵌入所选 ICC。: The output keeps {0}-bit color and transparency and embeds the selected ICC profile.
边框不能折叠、交叉或超出有效坐标。: The outline must stay convex and within the canvas coordinate range.
边框超出有效坐标。: The outline exceeds the supported coordinate range.
连接 Anthropic、OpenAI 兼容服务或本机 Ollama / LM: Connect Anthropic, an OpenAI-compatible service, or a local Ollama or LM Studio model to let AI use Strata's editing, history, and file commands.
连接成功，但模型未完成工具调用探测。请选择支持工具的模型。: The server connected, but the model did not complete the tool test. Choose a model that supports tools.
选择一个图层，查看并修改属性。: Select a layer to view and edit its properties.
选择可见且未锁定的图层。调整图层需要蒙版，选区范围需要像素层。: Choose visible, unlocked layers. Adjustment layers require a mask. Selected Pixels requires a pixel layer.
选择未锁定的图层。调整图层需要蒙版，选区范围需要像素层。: Choose unlocked layers. Adjustment layers require a mask. Selected Pixels requires a pixel layer.
钥匙串上一次读取仍在等待系统，请先解锁当前 Mac 会话。: A keychain request is still waiting for macOS. Unlock this Mac session and try again.
钥匙串读取超时。请解锁当前 Mac 会话后重试；本轮未发送模型请求。: The keychain request timed out. Unlock this Mac and try again. No model request was sent.
阈值按线性 RGB 差值计算，保留原透明度。: Threshold uses differences in linear RGB. Alpha is preserved.
预览尚未写入文档；点击应用保存，关闭预览恢复原效果。: Apply to keep the changes or turn off Preview to restore the original.
预设宽高须为正整数。: Preset width and height must be positive integers.
预设背景须为0–255的三个整数。: Preset background requires three integers from 0 to 255.
预设质量须为1–100的整数。: Preset quality must be a whole number from 1 to 100.
颜色按当前工作 RGB 百分比；点文字 Y 为首行基线，段落为框左上角。溢出内容: Color uses working RGB percentages. Y is the baseline for point type or the top of the paragraph box. Enlarge the box to show overflow.
